source.name: HC Neftekhimik official site: OLIMPBET стал партнёром ХК «Нефтехимик»
source.quote: Контракт рассчитан на три года, и в рамках сотрудничества логотип букмекера будет размещён на плечах игровой формы хоккеистов команды.
source.note: Club announcement of the three-year OlimpBet deal: the bookmaker's logo is placed on the shoulders of the team's playing kit.

source.name: HC Neftekhimik official site, club partners page
source.note: The only entry under 'Партнеры ХК «Нефтехимик». Сезон 2026-2027' is a logo with no alt text or link, captioned 'Официальный партнер'; the logo image (/upload/iblock/f40/zxsw9q14i85m5mkzyygrsjhjkdgqgr91.jpg) is the OLIMPBET wordmark. The page is undated; opened 2026-10-04.

summary: 2026-27 home kit. OlimpBet official partner; its logo is on the shoulders of the playing kit under a three-year deal announced by the club in September 2025, and it is the only partner listed for 2026-27 on the club partners page. Front-of-shirt and other shirt placements not documented on a source we could open.
